source.title: Banbridge Chronicle, 19 May 1961, p. 1 ("No contest for Banbridge Rural Council")
source.publisher: Banbridge Chronicle (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: the returning officer’s notice of result in the Banbridge Chronicle of 2 June 1961 and the nomination report of 19 May 1961.

note: Triennial election of Banbridge Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. Nineteen candidates came forward for twenty seats, so there was no election. The returning officer's notice of result prints the nineteen members returned and Quilly, for which no nomination was received, is added from the nomination report. No nomination; deemed to have been re-elected. Addresses and occupations printed with the names are not reproduced (privacy rule; gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
